Keep switch state, exhaustion, visibility and pool cost separate. Source tests/build do not close native, display or practice-development gaps. The original below-floor/no-native receipt is followed by KJ3AA’s first selected native use: ordered method lesson/readiness and one paid dream-divination energy cost on its named bundle. Native method sequence, one dream use and Anna payment were proved at this candidate’s slice, not every mechanism case. Cogitation refill is an explicit model assumption; 799 versus source-implied 797 and halfpence/share mismatch remain historical unresolved at this receipt, not silently corrected or current final-money claims. The real withheld dream differs from the disclosed account; burned notes do not erase remembered knowledge. Existing later runtime writers may supersede these gaps; no current-state assertion from this dated report.

Retain pathway/source/pool/residue/look reuse and use-based development as proposals. Clown at Sequence 8 is advancement within the Seer pathway, not a second pathway; local source identity and version still matter. A shared 240-minute residue chosen from unrelated precedents is not source calibration, and scaling a stated 230-pound formula to 5 pounds is not a canon anchor.
